description: This Java class 'PublisherService' provides service-layer methods for managing Publisher entities, including CRUD operations and counting, within a book project application.

classes.name: PublisherService
classes.description: Service class for managing Publisher entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and counting publishers.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Publisher by its ID, returning an Optional<Publisher>.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a Publisher if its name is not empty.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all Publisher entities.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of Publisher entities.
